product_one_liner.value: Leena AI provides autonomous AI colleagues that help large enterprises resolve employee requests and automate back-office workflows across HR, IT, Finance and Procurement.
product_one_liner.notes: The documentation describes digital workers that understand requests, take action and automate workflows across the four functions; the company announcement specifies large enterprises as the audience. Sources: https://docs.leena.ai/docs/welcome-to-leena-ai and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-leena-ai-to-accelerate-agentic-ai-across-the-enterprise-back-office-302914251.html.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page explains per-employee licensing and platform-plus-usage pricing, despite using a custom proposal rather than publishing fixed prices: https://leena.ai/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage contains a Beacon Mobility testimonial about adopting AI Colleagues and a customer playbook about CHRISTUS Health's AI adoption: https://leena.ai/. | named_customers.0: Beacon Mobility's testimonial describes involving AI Colleagues in its operations: https://leena.ai/. | named_customers.1: The homepage promotes a CHRISTUS Health customer adoption playbook covering 51,000 employees: https://leena.ai/.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 327 associated employees, which falls within 201-500. Confidence is reduced because another profile size field says 200 and associated-profile counts are not audited headcount: https://linkedin.com/company/leena-ai.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company announcement explicitly describes Leena AI as headquartered in New York: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-leena-ai-to-accelerate-agentic-ai-across-the-enterprise-back-office-302914251.html. | hq_country: The company announcement identifies New York as headquarters, and its executive profile identifies the country as the United States: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-leena-ai-to-accelerate-agentic-ai-across-the-enterprise-back-office-302914251.html and https://www.theofficialboard.com/org-chart/leena-ai?showSubsidiary=open.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2018: https://leena.ai/about-us.

eng_blog.notes: Two distinct posts describe the company's engineering work: its PDF parsing pipeline overhaul and its agentic-system benchmarking implementation. The first is authored by Ashish Ranjan and describes the engineering team's work; the second is by VP of Engineering Shubham Agarwal. Sources: https://leena.ai/blog/enterprise-grade-pdf-parsing-pipelines-accuracy-speed-and-scale-for-2025/ and https://leena.ai/blog/how-do-we-benchmark-an-agentic-ai-system-heres-our-approach-fully-open.

public_docs.notes: A public documentation portal includes a welcome reference, Getting Started guide and product changelog, rather than only a single FAQ. Sources: https://docs.leena.ai/docs/welcome-to-leena-ai, https://docs.leena.ai/docs/getting-started and https://docs.leena.ai/changelog/product-newsletter-august-2026.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Engineer posting, dated July 12, 2026, requires hands-on LLM, agentic-AI, RAG and prompt-engineering experience. Its title qualifies under the requested definition: https://jobs.greycroft.com/companies/leena-ai/jobs/86102009-ai-engineer.

model_provider.value: WorkLM (Leena AI's proprietary model), GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 and Llama 4.
model_provider.notes: The Orchestrator page explicitly names WorkLM, GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 and Llama 4 as supported reasoning models: https://leena.ai/platform/orchestrator.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA and GDPR. hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Senior Account Executive - Enterprise posting is dated October 2, 2026 and provides an active application link: https://apply.workable.com/leena-ai/jobs/view/01DB703E7F.md.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 2026 product newsletter announces that customers can now choose the model powering their AI Colleagues, a substantive capability rather than a bug fix or UI tweak. August falls within the requested six-month window: https://docs.leena.ai/changelog/product-newsletter-august-2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brent Ludwig's profile dates his start as Leena AI's VP of Professional Services to September 2026, within the requested 12-month window: https://linkedin.com/in/bludwig.
